card.name: Digits in war and disaster years
card.fires_on: Digits inside a 20th-century year (19__) in text about war, bombing or destruction, plus a few words in disaster or emergency-treatment settings. The year digits are the clearest case.

modes.label: Year digits in war history
modes.description: A digit inside a year like 1918 or 1943 in text about wars, bombings or destroyed buildings.
modes.example: The building was destroyed a fire after bombings on 14 July 1<<9>>43.

modes.label: Disaster or emergency words
modes.description: Words partway through or just after disaster or emergency terms such as tornadoes, earthquake or resuscitation.
modes.example: The recent rash of tornadoes in Oklahoma,<< which>> killed at least two dozen people

card.writes: It lowers disaster and emergency words (including Chinese ones) as the next word, so it holds back that vocabulary.
card.plain: It fires on year digits in war and destruction history and on words near disasters, and it steers the model away from saying disaster or emergency next.
